hushfacebook.title: v0.18.1
hushfacebook.body:
Settings are easier to get around now. Every section opens right on the main page, the rows are more compact, and Pause sits in the top bar. Feed videos can get their own play button, and new switches hide the comments under feed posts or the WhatsApp button on reels. Settings also come in Traditional Chinese. If Facebook crashed at startup for you with `Newest reels first` on, that's fixed too.

New in this release

- `Inline feed video controls` adds a play/pause button to feed videos, so playback can stay in the feed. It starts off under Playback. Tapping the video itself still opens it full screen (Refs #239).

- `Hide WhatsApp on reels` removes the direct WhatsApp button beside reels and videos. It starts off and leaves WhatsApp in the Share menu (Refs #243).

- `Hide comments under posts` stops feed posts from showing a few comments under their Like, Comment and Share buttons. Tapping Comment still opens them all, and the quick reply box stays. It starts off under Comments (Refs #253).

- Settings now include Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), contributed by JhouHank. When a phone's language names a Chinese script and a country that disagree, the script wins, so Traditional and Simplified text don't get mixed up (Refs #227).

- `Download button on reels` now has its own switch under Reels and Watch. Turn it off to keep Download in More without the sidebar button. It starts on, so the existing layout stays. Checked on an emulator, including a menu save opened in Photos and the main Download switch off (Refs #244).

Fixes

- Settings imports now update restart notices, including removing a notice when an import restores the value Facebook is already using. Edits made while an import runs stay consistent with the saved choices.

- Word filters recheck the space shared by both lists when you save or import. A preview or another open editor can no longer leave you with lists that won't import again.

- A retired unlock prompt can't cancel a newer prompt or replace its feedback.

- The Unlock button uses the lock screen's theme, keeping its text readable and its touch target intact when Facebook uses a different theme.

- Repeated taps open one settings screen. The last enabled way into settings stays protected after other switches change.

- Back to defaults updates launcher shortcuts straight away, while keeping Facebook's own shortcuts.

- Canceling a photo in Save all photos also stops the remaining photos.

- Photo, Story and GIF saves skip details Facebook has already released, including details nested inside a live post. Menu bookmarks use the same guard.

- Video joins stop copying samples before they exceed their size or storage allowance. The MP4 writer checks the complete output size before writing.

- Update checks enforce their time limit when response headers or the end of the body arrive late.

- A Story that reshares a Reel uses `Save video` for its main save option. It skips video details Facebook has already released, and the new label follows Facebook's language. Tests cover it against the real Facebook build, but it hasn't been tried on a live reshared Story yet (Refs #207).

- Crash files now identify the Facebook build and the patch bundle that produced them, even if settings won't open. They also include architecture details.

- Clearing Recently watched now discards pending watches, so an entry can't come back after Clear. Turning recording off also cancels pending entries, even if you turn it back on straight away.

- Facebook no longer crashes at startup with `Newest reels first` on when some reels haven't finished loading their details. Those reels keep Facebook's order and the rest still go newest first. Checked on a phone that crashed every launch before the fix (Refs #234, #246).

- `Tap anywhere on View more replies` now also covers the `View more replies` row with the down arrow at the end of an open reply thread. Before, it only reached the `View x replies` rows (Refs #219).

Other changes

- Every settings section now expands beneath its heading on the main page. Several can stay open, and tapping a heading again collapses it. Your open sections and scroll position come back after you clear a search, rotate the screen or restart from settings.

- Settings use compact, full-width rows and a smaller header. Pause moves to the top bar, with reports and restart under Support. The overview no longer shows the active-status card or Quick setups.

Behind the scenes

- Playback log checks no longer mistake a timestamp for a video speed.

- Fixture checks validate fingerprint uniqueness. Release receipts reject older retained runs that don't prove validation was enabled.

- Generated-file cleanup refuses paths through linked parent folders. Invalid CVSS vectors can't lower an advisory's score by repeating metrics.

- Overlapping device builds can't replace each other's argument files or outputs. Invalid patch options keep the previous signed APK.

- Retrying publication after an interrupted download check verifies the existing release's files without uploading them again. Drafts and failed lookups stop the retry.

- Device checks distinguish Facebook from a separately installed clone. The full audit checks for crashes after settings screenshots and recovery, too.

- Device log reads fail promptly after a disconnect. Walks and bytecode checks still attempt cleanup and report recovery errors.

- DASH test inputs are corrected, so the full suite reaches the intended cancellation and cleanup checks under the output limits.

- Device walks can scroll a navigation row below a caller's reserved screen area before tapping it. A fresh screen check still has to identify one target.

- Reel destination checks read the current Facebook activity directly, so another app's stalled diagnostic can't hide the viewer from the walk.

- Locale checks follow the app's language preference order, including its English fallback. The requested configuration and displayed page still have to match.

- Photo download and optional theme patches inspect fewer classes and skip unrelated call names. A full Facebook 584 comparison found the same hook sites. The earlier one-minute result on a phone used the recommended selection. Optional themes and other phones can take longer (Refs #236).

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `584.0.0.51.56`. On most phones that's build `475817393`, the arm64-v8a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 3827 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 102 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, the 64-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry. I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on an emulator signed in to a full account. 76 of 103 hook families ran there, `Newest reels first` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The startup crash fix was also checked on a phone whose feed crashed Facebook on every launch before it. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time.

- Every settings section now expands beneath its heading on the main page. Several can stay open, and tapping a heading again collapses it. Your open sections and scroll position come back after you clear a search, rotate the screen or restart from settings.

If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. It starts off.
- [#81](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/81) New **Hide tab badges** switch under Navigation. It clears the red dots and counts from the tabs at the bottom and from the Facebook button at the top. Want one of them back, say the Chats count? Turn on its Keep switch right below. Restart Messenger after a change. It's off until you turn it on.
- [#85](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/85) New **Hide the recent photo card** switch under Photos and videos. Take a screenshot or a photo and Messenger puts a card above the message box offering to send it. With this on, the card doesn't show up. Anything you took is still in the gallery button when you want to send it. It starts off.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) With two gallery apps on the phone and neither set as the default, **Open your gallery app** sent you to a Samsung Gallery that listed photos only. Videos show up there now too, and Android's list of apps to pick from still holds just your galleries.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) and [#82](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/82) **Open your gallery app** lets you pick several photos and videos at once. Pick two or more and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and the chat you came from at the top, so one Send gets them there. Pick just one and it opens in Messenger's editor like before. Samsung's Gallery now asks for a tap on Done even when you pick a single photo.

- [#79](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/79) An auto reply can send a picture too. Open a reply under **Auto reply** and tap **Add a picture**. The text goes out first and the picture follows a couple of seconds later in the same chat, with the same once-per-chat wait, Off and Pause as the text. HushMessenger keeps its own copy of the picture, so moving or deleting the original won't break the reply. If that copy is gone, or a Messenger update changed how photos are sent, the text still goes out on its own.

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 584.0.0.49.98 (version code 346814894) and no longer takes 583.0.0.29.95. Every switch was checked against it again, so update Messenger to 584 before you repatch.
- **Hide inbox ads** is gone. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, and Messenger 584 took out the ad cards the switch used to filter, so there's nothing left for it to hide. If you pick patches by hand in Morphe, it just won't be in the list anymore.

Conversations had grown too long to scan. The Chats filter still shows them.
- **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** now stay at the top of the icon's long-press menu while Messenger sits in the background. New messages used to push them below the four rows your launcher shows until you next opened and left Messenger. Android 9 and 10 still put them back only when Messenger opens or closes.
- Hiding Quick setups with a long press now names the button that brings it back, **Quick setups section** under Your choices. The old message sent you to the App tab you were already on, and the button talked about a home page that doesn't exist.
- A video picked in a chat whose access ran out before or during the send no longer gets **Fix videos that won't send** marked as failing in settings. It goes out the way Messenger would send it anyway.
- If the phone's sound encoder won't start while a video's sound is being fixed, it's let go right away instead of staying held until Messenger closes.
- The copies **Fix videos that won't send** makes of videos you pick now go a day after their last use, even if you never pick another video or you've turned the switch off. - Restoring your choices pops up how many of them it actually changed ("Changed 3 of 58 choices"), that none changed, or that they already match the backup, plus "Changes paused" or "Changes resumed" when the backup pauses or unpauses them. It used to count every choice in the backup, even ones that were already set that way, and the pause along with them. It only says they match when nothing in the backup was skipped or left off. Skipped choices and Auto reply staying off used to run past the end of that message. Now the whole result stays written under the backup buttons.
- When reading a choices file takes too long, the message says your choices didn't change. It used to warn that a saved file may be cut off, which is only true when saving one.
- If settings can't open from the side menu or the Messenger logo, two short messages now say so and then name the other way in. One message was too long and lost its second half.
- Picking a font file while **Use your own font** is off now says to turn the switch on, instead of telling you to restart Messenger. The file's name stays on the line under the button, where a long one can't push the rest off the message.
- **Use system emoji** loads the phone's emoji font once, even when Messenger asks for it from several threads at the same moment. Each thread could load its own copy before.
- When the message log can't save new messages (the phone's key store is busy, say), it tries again by itself 30 seconds later, then less often while it keeps failing. Those messages used to wait for the next notification and were lost if Messenger closed first.
- **Back to defaults**, the other Quick setups and **Clear log** each show an Undo button at the top of settings for about 10 seconds, and the emptied log shows one too. Undo leaves alone any switch you flipped yourself after the change.
- The **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** long-press shortcuts now tell your launcher when you use them, so it can rank them by use the way it does Messenger's own chat shortcuts.
- On a Root Mount install, **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** never actually showed up on Messenger's icon. Android turned down the icons they used. They show up now.
- Each way back into settings now has its own switch on the App tab, as asked in [HushFacebook#146](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook/issues/146). Next to **Hide the Menu row** there's **Hide the icon shortcuts**, which takes **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** off the menu you get by long-pressing Messenger's home screen icon, and **Ignore the logo long press**. The last way in that's still on can't be switched off: its switch goes gray and says why, and if a saved choice leaves nothing else, the icon shortcuts come back by themselves. Pause and safe mode leave these switches alone, since they're how you get back in to undo either. If the logo long press is what lets the Menu row stay hidden, the row comes back after an update or a repatch until one long press on the logo opens settings again.
- The two icon shortcuts now come from HushMessenger each time Messenger starts, on every install, which is what lets the new switch take them away. After updating, they show up again a moment after you first open Messenger. Messenger's own chat shortcuts can push them down that menu while it's open, so they move back to the top each time you leave Messenger. On a normal install, a copy you pinned to the home screen before this update stops working, so remove it and pin a new one. Copies pinned from now on turn gray while the shortcuts are hidden and work again once they're back.
- When Messenger's chat shortcuts already fill everything Android lets one icon hold, the lowest of them now make room, so **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** still get on. Android refused to add them to a full icon before. Those are the same chat shortcuts Android drops when Messenger adds one to a full icon itself.
- In the settings cards, the line between switches now sits below a switch's own buttons (Keep the Profile button, the bubble choices, the font file, message log and auto reply buttons) instead of between the switch and them. The last switch in a card no longer draws a second line just above the card's edge.
- With a keyboard or a remote, the focus outline on a filled settings button (Restart Messenger, Save, the selected tab and filter) is now two rings, a dark and a light one, so it shows up against the button and the page in both themes. The single gray ring was hard to see on the button's own color.
- The settings call each thing by one name now. Controls are the switches, and your choices are what you set them to. The clipboard backup buttons are **Copy choices** and **Paste choices**, since Export and Import sat right next to the file buttons and sounded like them. The third bubble mode is **Android bubbles**, which is what Android calls them. Flipping a control pops up "Hide stories and notes is on" instead of "Hide stories and notes on", and **Fix videos that won't send** says what it does before it names the sound format.
- Two patches got plainer names, in Morphe's patch list and in settings. **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is now **Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages**, and **Stop MQTT logging** is now **Stop live connection logging**. Morphe remembers your picks by name, so if you'd left either one out, it'll be picked again. Uncheck it before you repatch.
- With **Hide People tab**, **Hide Notifications tab** or **Hide Meta AI** on, the bar at the bottom now lights up the tab you're actually on. With People hidden, opening Notifications used to light up Menu instead.
- Some accounts get Meta's newer AI agent tab in the bar where the Meta AI tab usually sits. **Hide Meta AI** now hides that one too, and the bar still lights up the right tab. Restart Messenger to see it go.
- On a new install of a patched Messenger, **Bold** and **Italic** no longer show up in the text selection menu while **Bold and italic text** is off. Messenger's very first start turned them on, and they stayed there until you opened Messenger a second time. Updating over an existing install never did this.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** now hides the plain **Generate** button at the start of the sticker keyboard's Suggested row too. Accounts that get more than one sticker maker see that button instead of **Generate AI stickers**, and it opens a menu with AI stickers in it, so the switch used to miss it. The custom and music stickers in that menu are hidden along with it while the switch is on.
- With **Hide AI sticker tools** on, the rest of the Suggested row now moves up to fill the spot where **Generate** or **Generate AI stickers** used to sit. The button went away before, but its slot at the start of the row stayed blank.
- HushMessenger is now built for Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then repatch. Every patch still applies to Messenger 584 and the patch count is the same.

### Docs

- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a cloned Messenger showing the settings icon again, chats and calls notifying twice because of the Facebook app, and restoring chats with a PIN when the Google Drive restore errors out.

### Checks

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Messenger crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Messenger from the bundle, installs it in place on a leased phone or an emulator, opens both settings pages, a chat and the patched screens, then reads the crash buffer and writes the receipt publish asks for. Any Messenger crash fails the walk. Leaving out a page or a screen makes it partial, and neither one backs a release. The receipt also names the APK patched from the bundle and the one the phone actually ran, and publish wants them to match, so walking whatever was already installed (`-SkipPatch`) only counts when it's that same APK. A crash buffer the walk can't read fails it, and the script exits 0 only for a pass (2 for partial, 1 for a fail). A walk that finds the device busy keeps the APK it patched, so the next try goes straight to the device instead of patching again.
- The development release check, the one a held build goes through, fails when the source has no bundle timestamp. Before, a bundle and a source both missing one counted as a match there. The full release check already refused it, and now it says why.
- A Gradle run through this PC's build wrapper fails when the wrapper itself errors out before Gradle starts. It used to exit 0 and read as a pass.
- Recording a Messenger build with `CompatReport.java --save` refuses an APK that isn't signed by Facebook or Meta, or whose signer apksigner can't read. A record pins the APK's checksum, so a re-signed copy could have been written down as the stock build. The release build stage also checks each stock APK against the checksum in its record before patching it, and CompatReport looks for Python as `py`, `python3` or `python` (never the Windows Store stub) instead of assuming `python`.

- A Gradle run through this PC's build wrapper fails when the wrapper itself errors out before Gradle starts. It used to exit 0 and read as a pass.

* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first` keeps everything below your video in date order as posts load, and the tab starts on the newest post.
* Better sorting (#180). Profile grids get Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid loads up to 300 videos by itself, and swiping through them keeps that order.

* Thoughts (#186). `Turn on Thoughts` shows Thoughts for accounts TikTok left out.
* Original image formats (#229). Stickers that don't move are saved as TikTok sent them too.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` also covers the front flash and the fill light.
* Region locked features (#98). Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset says up front that only some videos get scrolling comments.

* On PineDrama, Hushfeed's settings now tell you to restart PineDrama instead of TikTok. That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. Other mentions of TikTok, like its servers or the TikTok Sans font, stay as they are (#156).
* New `Hide spam comments` switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments, off by default (#187). It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. It knows the common phrasings in English and the languages Hushfeed's settings come in, plus French. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).
* New `Allow photo comments` patch for PineDrama, with its switch off by default (#156). PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Turn the switch on in Hushfeed settings > Comments and restart, and the comment box asks the server like TikTok does.
* PineDrama moves to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new PineDrama from APKMirror before you patch it again. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. PineDrama 47.5.3 has no stories, HD upload choice or foldable comment panel, so `Story controls`, `Always upload in HD` and `Foldable split comment view` are TikTok only now. That makes 95 patches Morphe Manager offers for PineDrama. The rest lean on TikTok's LIVE rooms, feed buttons or resources that PineDrama doesn't have (#156).
* New `Report a newer phone to effects` switch, off by default (#176). Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". With the switch on, the effects server is told you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra. Sign-in and everything else still see your real phone. An effect your phone really can't run may still fail or look wrong.
* New `Load all saved stickers` patch, with no switch. PineDrama's sticker panel loaded only the first 100 stickers you saved and never asked for more, so the rest were missing from Saved. It now asks for all of them in one go. TikTok gets the same first request, and it still loads more by itself past that (#214).
* New `LIVE recording source` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Stream only` saves the room's own video like before. `Screen` records what your phone shows while you watch. Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. Both showed there because the Home tab stays selected on those tabs, and the filtered count sat right over their search boxes. They still show on For You and Following.
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a room's viewer ranking opens dark again. A shop room's Top customers ranking still keeps TikTok's light look, because its tab titles came out dark on dark (#159).
* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. * The build uses Gradle 9.8.2, up from 9.7.1. The build files now name the Guava advisory by its CVE number, CVE-2026-102554, because GitHub's global advisory database doesn't list its GHSA id.
* The README now lists the parts of Hushfeed's settings that an add-on bundle patched in beside it can count on, and a test fails if one of them changes. Anything else in the settings code can still move between releases.
* What's new now carries only the newest releases' notes, and its Full changelog button has the rest. Every release since 0.60.0 used to be built in, in all nine languages, and those notes alone were about 14% of the extension's size.
* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).
* New `Turn on Thoughts` switch in Hushfeed settings > App. It shows Thoughts on profiles and in your inbox, plus the prompt to share one, for accounts TikTok left out. It starts off, and TikTok's servers can still refuse a post (#186).
* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).
* `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` now also covers the front flash and the fill light, which used to push the screen to full brightness on their own. The flash still turns the screen white, just at your own brightness (#200).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.5.3 and run on a signed-in emulator. A walk through the whole app opened all 27 of its screens with no crash.
* Every patch applied to TikTok 47.5.3, and 94 applied to PineDrama 47.5.3 with none failing.
* An imported font drew PineDrama's settings and its drama feed after a restart, and bold titles stayed bold (#243).
* Sorting @natgeo's grid oldest first kept loading on its own up to 300 videos, and a tapped video opened that same video (#180).
* `Save the frame on screen as a photo` saved clean 720x1280 frames from a For You video and from a profile video.
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result opened a second time cleared again (#84).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, a tap paused or played in 8 to 43 ms, and two taps 150 ms apart paused and then played (#239).

Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. * With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a room's viewer ranking opens dark again. A shop room's Top customers ranking still keeps TikTok's light look, because its tab titles came out dark on dark (#159).
* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. TikTok used to hold each tap for a beat in case a second one followed, and two quick taps counted as a double tap that did nothing. Now each one counts (#239).
* The build uses Gradle 9.8.2, up from 9.7.1. The build files now name the Guava advisory by its CVE number, CVE-2026-102554, because GitHub's global advisory database doesn't list its GHSA id.
* The README now lists the parts of Hushfeed's settings that an add-on bundle patched in beside it can count on, and a test fails if one of them changes. Anything else in the settings code can still move between releases.
* What's new now carries only the newest releases' notes, and its Full changelog button has the rest. Every release since 0.60.0 used to be built in, in all nine languages, and those notes alone were about 14% of the extension's size.
* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).
* New `Turn on Thoughts` switch in Hushfeed settings > App. It shows Thoughts on profiles and in your inbox, plus the prompt to share one, for accounts TikTok left out. It starts off, and TikTok's servers can still refuse a post (#186).
* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).
* `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` now also covers the front flash and the fill light, which used to push the screen to full brightness on their own. The flash still turns the screen white, just at your own brightness (#200).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.5.3 and run on a signed-in emulator. A walk through the whole app opened all 27 of its screens with no crash.
* Every patch applied to TikTok 47.5.3, and 94 applied to PineDrama 47.5.3 with none failing.
* An imported font drew PineDrama's settings and its drama feed after a restart, and bold titles stayed bold (#243).
* Sorting @natgeo's grid oldest first kept loading on its own up to 300 videos, and a tapped video opened that same video (#180).
* `Save the frame on screen as a photo` saved clean 720x1280 frames from a For You video and from a profile video.
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result opened a second time cleared again (#84).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, a tap paused or played in 8 to 43 ms, and two taps 150 ms apart paused and then played (#239).

hushgram.title: v0.0.16
hushgram.body:
The accent color can follow your wallpaper now with Material You on Android 12 and newer, and the red badges can take your color too. You can add your own story fonts, pick a different app icon and hide the rows you never use in Instagram's settings. Messages can go full screen, tall reels can fill the screen, and a left swipe on a reel opens the profile. A new lock keeps HushGram's settings from changing for up to 72 hours. The glass tab bar and the like animations got a round of fixes too.

New in this release

- `Accent color`: `Material You` is a new choice in the `Color` list on Android 12 and newer. Buttons, links and highlights take your wallpaper's colors, in light and dark mode, after a restart. Asked for in #187 and #264.

- `Accent color`: New `Badges in the accent color` switch under it, off to start. The red dots and counts for new messages and notifications take the color you picked, after a restart. Asked for in #315.

- `Story text fonts`: new patch, off to start. Add .ttf or .otf files under `Your story fonts` in Stories, and they show up by file name in the story text editor after Instagram's own fonts. Asked for in #275.

- `Story text fonts`: New `Emoji font in story text` switch under Stories, off to start. Turning it on asks for an emoji font file (.ttf), and the emoji you type in story text draw in it. Asked for in #275.

- `Pick the app icon`: new patch. `App icon` under Layout swaps the home screen icon for HushGram's, or Instagram's glyph on black or plum. It changes once you leave Instagram. Starts on Instagram's own. Asked for in #284.

- `Hide rows in Instagram's settings`: new patch. Open Instagram's Settings and activity once, then untick the rows you never use under `Rows in Instagram's settings` in Layout and they're gone from that screen. Every row shows to start. Asked for in #235 and #250.

- `Full screen Reels and Home`: New `Full screen Messages` switch under Messages. Your messages and open chats hide the bars picked in `Bars to hide`, and a swipe in from the edge brings them back for a moment. Typing and Back work as usual. Asked for in #288.

- `Full screen Reels and Home`: New `Fill the screen` switch under Full screen Reels, off to start. Tall reels that showed black bars above and below fill the screen instead, trimmed a little at the sides. Square and wide videos still fit. Reported in #288.

- `Save profile picture`: New `Profile extras button` switch, off to start. It puts a small button next to the three dots on a profile that opens the profile actions you turned on. The three-dot menu keeps its rows. Asked for in #234.

- `Change the like animation`: The `Like animation` list now shows a heart under it and plays each one as you tap it. OK saves the one you like, and Cancel keeps the old one. Asked for in #299.

- `Stop Reels scrolling`: New `Take a scroll break` list under Reels, off to start. After 10 to 60 minutes on Home, Reels and Explore, a break screen covers them for 5 minutes. Messages, your profile and the tab bar still work. Asked for in #297.

- `HushGram settings`: New `Lock these settings` row under Pause HushGram. Pick a 1 to 72 hour wait and every setting greys out, Pause included. `Ask to unlock` starts the wait (a tap stops it), then the page opens for 10 minutes. Asked for in #301.

- `HushGram settings`: A small dot now marks settings added since you last looked, and the category row that holds them. It clears once you've been through that page. A fresh install shows none. Asked for in #274.

- `Clean up Reels`: New `Hide the Friends tab on Reels` switch under Reels, off to start. It takes the Friends tab off the top of the Reels tab, and Reels moves over to fill the space. No restart needed. Asked for in #300.

- `Hide the Reels tab`: New `Logo and titles at the start` switch under Tab bar, for accounts where Instagram moved the Home logo and bar titles to the middle. It puts them back at the start. Asked for in #310.

- `Hide the Reels tab`: New `Hide the Messages tab` switch under Tab bar takes the Messages button off the tab bar, no restart needed. If Home's header has no Messages button, HushGram adds one so your chats stay a tap away. Asked for in #298 and #307.

- `Hide suggested posts`: New `Hide the caught up card` switch under Feed, off to start. It folds the "You've seen the latest posts" card, so Home runs straight on into the rest of the feed. With no new posts, the card stays. Reported in #307.

- `Download any video`: Details has a Copy caption without hashtags row for captions that have them. It drops a closing block of tags and the dots above it, and a tag inside a sentence keeps its word. Reported in #282.

- `Swipe left to open the profile`: new patch, off to start. Turned on under Reels, a left swipe on a reel slides in the creator's profile, like Instagram used to. A right swipe or Back on that profile returns to the reel. Takes a restart. Asked for in #245 and #283.

- `Full resolution photos`: New `Full size covers` switch under Feed. Reel covers and grid pictures load at full size, so Download cover saves 1080 pixels wide, not 240 to 480. It uses a lot more data, so it starts off. Takes a restart. Asked for in #214.

- `Glass tab bar`: With `Liquid glass look` on, the active tab sits in a raised glass bubble that swells while it moves and bends what's behind it on Android 13 and up. New `Blur strength` row sets how much the pill blurs. Asked for in #289.

- `Hide profile tabs`: `Tabs on profiles` is now two rows, `Tabs on your profile` and `Tabs on other profiles`, so Reels can go from yours and stay on everyone else's. Your old pick covers both until you change one. Asked for in #296.

Fixes

- `Glass tab bar`: The outline Instagram draws round the message count and the dots on the tab bar is clear now, so it doesn't sit on the glass as a solid ring. The dot grows a little into the space the outline took. Reported in #315.

- `Hide suggested posts`: `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` takes the question off Reels too, the Not interested and Interested row under a reel. Before, only Home's bubble went. (#131)

- `Glass tab bar`: With `Full screen Reels` on, the floating pill dropped by the navigation bar's height every time you switched to Reels, then jumped back up on the other tabs. It stays at one height on every tab now. Reported in #285.

- `Glass tab bar`: A video playing under the glass pill no longer turns the pill black. Some videos play on a layer the blur couldn't see, so it blurs a small copy of the video's picture now. Reported in #144.

- `Change the like animation`: The animation you picked plays on Instagram 452's feed and Reels hearts again, for a double tap and for the heart button. 452 had been showing its usual heart there. Reported in #299.

- `View stories anonymously`: With `Gray out stories you've watched` on, stories you've watched now move behind the new ones in the story row at the top of Home too. Before, only the stories inside the feed were reordered. (#241)

- `Read messages without the seen receipt`: With `Keep chats unread here` off, a chat you opened could still flip back to unread after a refresh. Now it stays read until a new message comes in. (#186)

- `Download any reel`: The Details row in a reel's menu shows Instagram's info icon now. It used to wear Download's arrow. (#282)

- `Download any reel`: A photo post opened on the Reels tab or from a hashtag page gets Details in its menu too, under Download. Until now only videos and photos with music had it. (#282)

- `Start Home on Following`: With `Only accounts you follow` on, Back to home at the end of your Following feed takes you back up to the newest post. Before, the link did nothing.

- `HushGram settings`: Opening an Instagram link or a notification while HushGram settings are up closes them, so you land where it leads. A link that arrives while they're still opening wins too. The tab used to change behind them.

- `Clean up Reels`: With `Keep clear mode on`, starting a swipe back and letting the reel snap back into place could end clear mode on that reel and bring its buttons back. It stays in clear mode now. Reported in #233.

- `HushGram settings`: With a HushGram PIN set, importing a settings file no longer calls `Lock your messages` and `Lock all of Instagram` unknown settings. Those switches stay as they are until you change them on the settings page.

- `Download any video`: The Details row in a feed post's menu shows Instagram's info icon now, not Download's arrow.

- `Hide suggested people on profiles`: `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` now also takes the Suggested tab off other people's follow lists, and the Suggested for you block under their mutual followers. Before, it only reached the bottom of the followers and following lists. Reported in #302.

- `Blur the bars around Reels`: The band behind the clock and the gesture bar's strip stayed black on Reels. Both show the reel blurred now, a little darker behind the clock under white icons so the time stays easy to read. Reported in #258.

- `Sanitize sharing links`: Share and Copy link in Instagram's in-app browser move an Instagram page's link to your Sharing domain now, as the share sheet and Copy link on a post already did. Those two had still said instagram.com. Thanks to @Aholicknight for the fix in #304.

- `Find the reel you came from`: A trial reel from someone else isn't on their profile, so the search used to keep scrolling and then give up. Once the grid has gone past the reel's date it stops and says the reel isn't there. Reported in #225.

Other changes

- With `Send downloads to another app` on, the first download after each start shows a short note saying this switch opened the share sheet and where to turn it off. It looked just like Instagram's own Share. Reported in #305.

- `Upload stories at full quality`: The switch's description now says what you actually get. Video stories still go up at 1080p, but Instagram shrinks every story video to 720p on its servers, so viewers see only a small difference. (#37)

Behind the scenes

- HushGram builds on Gradle 9.8.2 now, with androidx.annotation 1.11.0 and commons-lang3 3.21.0. Each new download was checked against its publisher's checksums before it went on the verification list. The patches themselves don't change.

- The HushGram settings code is split into one file per category, so a row is easier to find. Every category lists the same rows in the same order, and search finds the same ones.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `452.1.0.53.64`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6335 runtime tests passed locally. All 2129 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 builds took 116 of the 117 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator, then opened the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox and a profile from a fresh start, and Instagram didn't crash once.

- `Clean up Reels`: With `Keep clear mode on`, starting a swipe back and letting the reel snap back into place could end clear mode on that reel and bring its buttons back. It stays in clear mode now. Reported in #233.

- `HushGram settings`: With a HushGram PIN set, importing a settings file no longer calls `Lock your messages` and `Lock all of Instagram` unknown settings. Those switches stay as they are until you change them on the settings page.

- `Download any video`: The Details row in a feed post's menu shows Instagram's info icon now, not Download's arrow.

- `Hide suggested people on profiles`: `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` now also takes the Suggested tab off other people's follow lists, and the Suggested for you block under their mutual followers. Before, it only reached the bottom of the followers and following lists. Reported in #302.

- `Find the reel you came from`: A trial reel from someone else isn't on their profile, so the search used to keep scrolling and then give up. Once the grid has gone past the reel's date it stops and says the reel isn't there. Reported in #225.

Other changes

- With `Send downloads to another app` on, the first download after each start shows a short note saying this switch opened the share sheet and where to turn it off. It looked just like Instagram's own Share. Reported in #305.

- `Upload stories at full quality`: The switch's description now says what you actually get. Video stories still go up at 1080p, but Instagram shrinks every story video to 720p on its servers, so viewers see only a small difference. (#37)

Behind the scenes

- HushGram builds on Gradle 9.8.2 now, with androidx.annotation 1.11.0 and commons-lang3 3.21.0. Each new download was checked against its publisher's checksums before it went on the verification list. The patches themselves don't change.

- The HushGram settings code is split into one file per category, so a row is easier to find. Every category lists the same rows in the same order, and search finds the same ones.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `452.1.0.53.64`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).
